workstream.name: ecl v1 — the real interpreter (design/workstream-v1.md)
workstream.unlocks: M7 can build spawn/par-each on the same isolated-application and outcome contracts, while M9 can reuse the embedded-source bootstrap for shipped stdlib modules and add the deliberately deferred filesystem/environment words (`slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and source-defined `lines`).

problemStatement: The M5 interpreter has a complete kernel data plane, but quotation-taking iteration still does not exist, inline control is incomplete, the public reader cannot yet be reified with `parse`, and the three derived bootstrap words are assembled in Zig rather than loaded from inspectable ecl source. Without M6 there is no contract-checked generic path for higher-order array work, no late-binding-safe bridge from quotations to kernels, and no differential proof that fusion is semantically invisible.
solutionSummary: Add one defunctionalized isolated-application continuation to the existing frame machine, then implement each/each2/for/fold/scan/infra and the remaining primitive inline control in a separately budgeted combinator component. Normalize `cond` and source-defined `case` around flat odd clause lists: cond alternates test/action quotations, while case alternates inert key values/action quotations; both end in a mandatory else quotation and prevalidate before selection. Build one closed, declarative phrase registry over the existing kernel operation enums: the matcher accepts arbitrary exact phrase shapes plus an execution context, so combinator quotations and the direct source body `(dup grade at)` share one mechanism. Every fast path resolves all referenced words at application time, accepts only the expected core primitive identities, and otherwise executes the ordinary late-bound frame-machine path. Replace host-assembled wrap/pair/sort with an embedded `src/prelude.ecl` loaded through the ordinary reader into the writable core before it is sealed, expose that same poll-aware reader/provenance route as the pure `parse` primitive, then define the complete M6 [E] vocabulary there. Defer `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and their source-defined `lines` consumer to M9. Add an in-process forced-generic differential command, extend the frozen-oracle coverage, and lock the release-binary contracts in SourceHut.

mergabilityStrategy.featureFlagStrategy: Ship ungated. These are missing core-language words in a clean-slate interpreter, not a rollout over persisted or remotely served behavior. `machine.IdiomMode.generic_only` is an in-process verification seam used by tests; it is not a CLI flag, environment variable, or production rollout control.
mergabilityStrategy.patchOrderingStrategy: Patch 1 is a behavior-preserving frame/component seam with skipped proof names. Patches 2 and 4 may proceed in parallel after it: Patch 2 implements generic combinators, while Patch 4 makes ordinary reading poll-aware, exposes pure `parse`, and replaces the host prelude bootstrap. Patch 3 requires both the generic fallback and source-honest sort body; Patch 5 requires the generic combinators and embedded loader. Patch 6 runs after Patches 3 and 5 and wires the full differential/acceptance matrix into CI.

currentStateAnalysis: Grounded on clean `master` at `9136639` (`Rename outcome extractor to or-raise`), synchronized with `origin/master`. SourceHut build 1860751 is green for that commit, and local `zig build test` passes. M5 landed as planned at `d88f195` with post-landing feedback hardening in `fea9fde` and `ab36184`: kernels install through `prims.install` -> `kernels.install`, poll-aware traversal is enforced by `src/source_audit.zig`, tests inspect behavior rather than other source files, and the frozen Rust oracle remains untouched. The landed implementation intentionally retains three M6 staging seams: `src/prelude.zig` host-assembles wrap/pair, `src/kernel_order.zig::install` host-assembles sort, and `src/kernel_sequence.zig::findPrimitive` remains primitive until each exists. `src/machine.zig::Frame` is 48-byte-bounded and already supplies base-index stack barriers for attempt/module plus cross-module effect checks, but it has no reusable per-application continuation; `prims.zig` implements call/dip/if/while directly and installs no each/each2/for/fold/scan/infra/times/cond/parse. Resolution is already late-bound through `machine.resolveName`, with `Resolution.origin` distinguishing core from direct/used/module bindings, which is the guard seam M6 needs. The ordinary reader already returns reified forms plus list-identity span tables and the Session archive already owns those roots, but lexer/parser/binder traversals have no Machine poller and no primitive exposes them. The audited rows are values+RC 2,248/2,300, reader 1,123/1,250, machine 2,290/2,300, modules/registry 1,300/1,300, bootstrap prelude 29/100, total core 6,990/9,500, and kernels 3,571/5,500; M6 therefore must relocate existing control code out of the nearly-full machine row, fit reader polling in its existing headroom, and stay within the dedicated 900-line combinator row rather than increasing existing caps. Planning resolves the sort conflict with one context-parameterized recognizer, cond as a prevalidated flat odd quotation list, and case as the analogous flat odd list whose left slots are inert values. It assigns pure reader reification (`parse`) to M6 and defers `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and `lines` to M9.

operationalConsiderations.externalSystemAccess: No new network, database, queue, secret, environment, or filesystem dependency is introduced. `parse` operates only on its in-memory string and `src/prelude.ecl` is compiled into the executable with `@embedFile`; neither may consult the current directory or ECL_PATH. `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and `lines` remain absent until M9. SourceHut remains the existing forge/CI runtime and needs no new credential or IAM grant.
operationalConsiderations.crossRuntimeContracts: Patch 6 continues the existing Zig-binary/frozen-Rust-oracle process boundary. The Rust tree is producer-of-reference-output only and is never modified; the Zig test runner compares normalized exit/output/error behavior for the shared M6 subset, including `parse`, while Zig-only post-freeze syntax such as normalized case clauses is covered natively. The new fast/generic differential is in-process and compares Values, heap representation, complete error dicts, and f64 bits before rendering, so it does not rely on a lossy text protocol.
operationalConsiderations.failureBehavior: Every isolated application is a frame-machine continuation: quotation failure unwinds through the existing crash-only path, destroys the current lazy child scope, releases retained inputs/results, and restores the enclosing attempt/unit boundary. Contract errors name the combinator, zero-based element index when applicable, expected effect, seeded depth, and observed depth. Type/conform/domain errors are raised before scheduling impossible work; cond rejects an empty/even list or any non-quotation member before executing its first test, and case rejects an empty/even clause list or any non-quotation action/else before comparing a key. `parse` rejects a non-string with `'type`; malformed or incomplete text becomes `'parse` at source `<parse>` without executing any returned form. Long empty quotations, result materialization, recognition guards, string encoding, reader/binder traversals, and reductions charge the existing unit-wide poll budget. Bootstrap OOM propagates as OOM; malformed embedded source, evaluation failure, or a nonempty bootstrap stack is an interpreter-build defect and prevents Session construction/core sealing rather than becoming a recoverable user load error.
operationalConsiderations.concurrencyAndIdempotency: M6 starts no threads and mutates no process-global recognition cache. Generic applications allocate a fresh lazy child Scope per application and therefore preserve the existing rule that session-visible environments have one writer; recognition resolves only for the duration of one guard and retains no Resolution or BindingLease afterward. Re-running Session initialization produces a fresh core and archive from the same embedded bytes, and failed initialization tears both down. These choices keep Unit state movable and leave M7 free to schedule it without introducing cache invalidation or cross-unit writes.
operationalConsiderations.rollbackStrategy: There is no persisted data, migration, external write, or one-way operator action. Revert in reverse dependency order: remove Patch 6 CI wiring, source definitions, reader reification/loader migration, recognition, generic combinators, then the Patch 1 seam. Each intermediate commit builds and tests; Patch 4 explicitly preserves wrap/pair/sort behavior while changing their authority/provenance and adds only the pure `parse` surface, so reverting it restores the M5 host bootstrap without converting user data.

functionalChanges.description: `each`, `for`, `fold`, and `scan` execute quotations on a fresh isolated substack and disposable child scope for every leading-axis element, enforce their d.14 effects after each application, preserve ordered execution, and specialize collected results through the ordinary list constructor.

`each2` accepts two conforming lists or broadcasts one atom across the other list, rejects two atoms and unequal leading lengths, applies `( a b -- c )` in fresh scopes, and returns the same generic-empty representation on every empty route.

`infra` runs its quotation once with the input list's elements as the entire isolated substack and returns every remaining result as one list, with no fixed effect contract and no leakage into the enclosing stack/scope.

`times` and `cond` complete the primitive inline-control surface without host recursion: times executes a quotation exactly n times on the current stack, while cond consumes one flat nonempty odd-length list of quotations, treats alternating entries as tests/actions and the rightmost entry as mandatory else, then runs the first selected action or else.

Every isolated contract failure is immediate and includes the zero-based element index when applicable, the expected effect, seeded depth, and observed depth; long empty applications and result construction remain cancellable and all OOM paths release continuation state.

The closed phrase registry fuses unary and constant-binary `each`, single-binary `each2`, strictly sequential +/*/min/max `fold`/`scan`, and direct `(dup grade at)` application through one context-parameterized matcher, only when every referenced word resolves to the expected core primitive identity; every miss or redefinition uses the ordinary late-bound path.

Recognition is unobservable: automatic and forced-generic runs agree on structural value, printed representation, complete error dict, and f64 bits; empty and failing inputs follow generic semantics rather than leaking leaf tags or fast-path diagnostics.

Session startup reads the build-embedded `src/prelude.ecl` through the ordinary reader, archives its root/spans, evaluates it on an empty stack rooted at the writable core, and freezes the core only after successful empty-stack completion without filesystem or ECL_PATH access.

`wrap`, `pair`, and `sort` cease to have host-assembled definitions: `body` returns exactly `(() cons)`, `(() cons cons)`, and `(dup grade at)` from embedded source, and errors inside them retain `prelude.ecl` provenance.

The complete agreed non-concurrent M6 [E] dataflow/control vocabulary is source-defined and callable: nip, keep, bi, tri, bi2, both, when, unless, case, signum, clamp, last, wrap, pair, pack, append, empty?, zip, min-of, max-of, sort, at-or, pairs, filter, partition, any?, all?, sum, prod, mean, print, and inspect. `case` consumes a subject plus one flat nonempty odd list alternating inert key values/action quotations and ending in an else quotation; it prevalidates all action slots, compares keys left-to-right with whole-value `match`, permits duplicates with first match winning, consumes subject/clauses before running exactly one action, and never executes a key. `lines` remains absent until M9 supplies `slurp`.

The full source-defined failure vocabulary is live: fail raises a `'user` error dict, ok? probes an outcome, or-raise returns results or rethrows the original error unchanged, and or-else returns results or its fallback.
`find` moves from its provisional M5 primitive to an ordinary source body built from each/match/where while preserving first-index-or-len behavior and remaining reflectable through `body`.

`zig build differential` enumerates every idiom-registry entry, proves the automatic run actually hit its intended fast path, compares it with forced generic execution across success/error/empty/representation/float cases, and runs as a blocking SourceHut job.

The frozen Rust PoC remains unchanged while its shared M6 combinator and prelude behavior is exercised against the Zig binary, and release-artifact acceptance locks DoD-7, DoD-9, DoD-10, DoD-14's each probe, and DoD-27.

`parse` is the pure public reader reified: it consumes only a string, UTF-8-encodes and reads it with bounded polling, returns all unevaluated top-level forms as one generic quotation, and archives nested spans under source `<parse>` so a later `call` reports that provenance. Non-string input is `'type`; malformed and incomplete input are `'parse`; cancellation and OOM propagate without a partial stack result. `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and `lines` are not introduced in M6.

acceptanceCriteria: `[1 2 3] (dup *) each` returns `[1 4 9]`; `[1 2 3] 0 (+) fold` returns `6`; `[1 2 3] 0 (+) scan` returns `[1 3 6]`; and ordered for produces its visible effects in element order.
`[10 20] (dup) each` fails at element 0 with `'kind 'contract` and structural data for index 0, expected `( a -- b )`, seeded 1, and observed 2.

`[1 2 3] 10 (pair) each2` and `10 [1 2 3] (pair) each2` both broadcast; two atoms are `'type`, unequal list lengths are `'conform`, and every empty route prints `()` rather than a representation-dependent leaf.
`[1 2 3] (dup 'k set k *) each pop k` fails `'undefined-word` for k after successful applications, and equivalent probes cover each2/for/fold/scan/infra.
`[1 2 3] (dup +) infra` returns `[1 2 3 3]` while leaving values below the application boundary untouched; arbitrary zero/many results are legal.

times is nonnegative-int checked, ordered, cancellable even for an empty quotation, and constant-frame; `[(0) (111) (222)] cond` returns 222, `[(1) (111) (222)] cond` returns 111, `[()] cond` is a valid no-op, empty/even clause lists are `'shape`, non-quotation entries are `'type`, and every malformed list is rejected before any test runs.

`3 [1 ("one") 3 ("three") ("other")] case` returns `"three"`; `(missing) [(missing) (7) (9)] case` returns 7 without resolving `missing`; `1 [1 (10) 1 (20) (30)] case` returns 10; and `1 [1 (10) 2 20 (30)] case` is `'type` before the matching first action runs. Empty/even clause lists are `'shape`, non-list clauses and non-quotation action/else slots are `'type`, keys may be any Values, matching is whole-value `match`, and only the selected action or else executes.

The recognition manifest covers unary each, left/right constant-binary each, binary each2, +/*/min/max fold/scan, and direct `(dup grade at)` application; every case records one automatic hit and zero forced-generic hits.
Redefining `+` with `(pop pop 42) '+ def [1 2 3] 0 (+) fold` returns `42`, records no idiom hit, and a redefinition performed by one generic application is visible to the next application.

For every idiom entry, automatic and generic-only execution agree on structural value, canonical brackets, full error dict, and bit-identical floats; `[0.1 0.2 0.3] 0 (+) fold` proves strict left-to-right floating reduction.

Long combinator loops, empty quotation iterations, guard scans, reductions, final list materialization, UTF-8 string encoding, ignored-comment/token/string scanning, binder lowering, and parsed-form/span materialization observe cancellation within the existing 65,536 logical-element bound; targeted tests distinguish cancellation during each actual traversal from a poll only before it.

`src/prelude.zig` contains only bootstrap machinery; startup reads embedded `src/prelude.ecl` through reader.read, retains its root/span tables in the Session archive, runs with core as the writable root and an empty stack, then seals core.
`'wrap body 'pair body 'sort body 'pack body` prints `(() cons) (() cons cons) (dup grade at) (() swap (cons) times)` and a failure inside an embedded definition reports source `prelude.ecl`.

The complete agreed non-concurrent M6 [E] vocabulary is installed as `.word` bindings and behaviorally exercised, while `par-each` remains absent until M7 and `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and `lines` remain absent until M9; no host file contains an alternate derived body.

`"42" parse first` returns 42 and `"missing" parse` returns `(missing)` without execution; `"(missing)" parse first call` fails with source `<parse>`. Multiple top-level forms retain order in one generic quotation, malformed and incomplete text are `'parse`, non-string input is `'type`, and forced cancellation/allocation failures during encoding, lexing, binder inspection, and archive transfer leave the stack and archive valid.

Copying only the release ecl binary into an empty temporary directory and running with ECL_PATH unset still makes all embedded words and pure `parse` available, `1 2 3 4 4 pack` returns `[1 2 3 4]`, and no deferred M9 filesystem/environment word is installed.

Malformed embedded source, bootstrap evaluation failure, and leftover stack values are rejected before core sealing by the loader test interface; production Session initialization treats them as build defects, while every injected allocation failure is released and returned as OOM.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Use one generic base-index isolated-application continuation rather than a distinct frame family for each combinator.
explicitOpinions.rationale: attempt/module and cross-module effects already prove stack-depth contracts and unwind ownership. One callback/state frame keeps every new control frame <=48 bytes, centralizes child-scope destruction and error data, and gives M7 one substrate to reuse.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Relocate call/dip/if/while into the new combinator component before adding behavior.
explicitOpinions.rationale: The machine row has only ten lines of headroom while M6 has a dedicated 900-line row. Moving existing control adapters preserves behavior and makes additions displace within the correct component instead of raising a frozen cap.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Cond consumes one flat nonempty odd-length list of quotations; the rightmost quotation is the required else branch.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Alternating test/action positions reuse the flat adjacency convention already established by dict-of without nested pair punctuation. The enclosing list supplies the dynamic boundary, the mandatory else makes every valid cond exhaustive without a new no-cond error, and `()` remains an explicit no-op else. Prevalidating odd length and quotation types prevents malformed control data from producing partial effects.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Case uses the same flat odd clause shape as cond, but its left slots are inert Values rather than predicate quotations.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Case already has a subject, so executable selectors would duplicate cond and make it unclear which stack state predicates observe. Inert keys give the compact `key action ... else` syntax, admit every structural key kind, preserve ordinary whole-value `match`, and make duplicate handling deterministically leftmost. Prevalidating every action/else quotation before matching prevents an early key from hiding malformed later control data.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Recognition is a per-entry structural guard, never a cache.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Resolution.origin plus the expected primitive function identifies the core binding at the point of application. Retaining resolutions or keying by generations would either violate full late binding or recreate invalidation machinery the architecture explicitly rejected.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Use one context-parameterized phrase recognizer rather than a combinator-only matcher plus a special sort hook.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Pattern complexity and entry context are orthogonal. A closed declarative registry can match arbitrary exact phrases and select context-specific targets while remaining small: M6 supplies direct, each, each2, fold, and scan contexts, with `(dup grade at)` as the first direct-source pattern. Matching at application time and identity-guarding every referenced word preserves honest source, full generic late binding, and future growth without a second recognizer.

explicitOpinions.opinion: The forced-generic mode is test-only Session/Unit state, not a user-visible switch.
explicitOpinions.rationale: The language has one semantics and fusion must be invisible. A CLI/env switch would accidentally create two supported execution modes; an in-process seam is enough to prove equivalence and fast-path reachability.

explicitOpinions.opinion: A differential case must assert a fast-path hit before comparing results.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Otherwise an empty recognizer makes every automatic/generic comparison pass vacuously and the named M6 deliverable proves nothing.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Float fold and scan fast paths are strict sequential left folds.
explicitOpinions.rationale: This is d.23's explicit bit-level contract. Integer/min/max may gain exact reassociation later, but M6 need not take that optimization to establish a real fused path.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Fast paths conform to generic empty and error behavior, even when a direct leaf kernel would choose a different empty representation or attach different indexed diagnostics.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Leaf kinds are representation-only but brackets and string-only applicability are observable. Recognition cannot leak either representation tags or a richer/different error payload.

explicitOpinions.opinion: The embedded prelude is parsed and evaluated on every Session construction until profiling justifies a reproducible system image.
explicitOpinions.rationale: This keeps ecl source as the single semantic authority and retains ordinary source spans/body reflection. A snapshot is explicitly post-v1 and must never become a second body encoding.

explicitOpinions.opinion: M6 excludes par-each even though it is [E].
explicitOpinions.rationale: Its dependencies and leftmost-error/join-order contract belong to M7's scheduler milestone. Installing a body that cannot execute would create a misleading core surface and preempt M7's licensed chunking override.

explicitOpinions.opinion: M6 adds pure `parse`; M9 owns `slurp`, `spit`, `getenv`, and therefore `lines`.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Parse is the reader's value-level reflection boundary and directly completes M6's code/prelude story without acquiring external capabilities. Slurp, spit, and getenv are host IO/environment effects that belong with M9's scripting stdlib; lines cannot be honestly installed before slurp exists. changes: Install each/each2/for/fold/scan/infra/times/cond as env.Primitive bindings through combinators.install; use the existing quotation/list type check and structural d.19 error helpers.

For each, each2, for, fold, and scan, retain the source sequence/quotation once, preallocate exact result storage where the result count is known, and schedule each element with Machine.beginIsolatedApplication. Each application gets a new env.Scope.lazy rooted at the combinator's current scope; successful completion destroys it before the next application.

Enforce effects by depth: each `(1 -- 1)`, each2 `(2 -- 1)`, for `(1 -- 0)`, fold/scan `(2 -- 1)`. Contract failures include data.index, data.effect as the actual quotation `(a -- b)`/`(a b -- c)`/`(a --)`/`(acc a -- acc)`, seeded, and observed; the empty input performs no application and therefore cannot fail a quotation contract.

Implement each2's total domain: list/list requires equal leading length; list/atom and atom/list broadcast without allocating a replicated operand; atom/atom is type. Empty success materializes the same generic empty list as the generic application semantics, including when an operand is an empty string leaf.

Infra accepts only a list, seeds one isolated substack with all elements, runs q once with no result-count contract, then materializes the entire remainder as one list and restores the outer stack exactly.

Times accepts a nonnegative int and executes q inline on the current stack/scope exactly n times via a constant-space back-edge. Cond accepts one list with length 2n+1 for n>=0; it first validates that every element is a quotation/list, then treats indices 0/1, 2/3, ... as inline test/action pairs and the rightmost quotation as mandatory else. Empty/even lists are shape, non-list elements are type, and validation completes before any test can have effects.

For each cond test, remember the current base depth, run inline in the current scope, require exactly one additional 0/1 boolean, and pop it. On true schedule only the adjacent action; on false continue; if every test is false schedule the rightmost else. Actions and else have unconstrained inline effects, `[()] cond` is a valid no-op, and no valid input has an unmatched fallthrough.

Charge advanceKernel(1) on every continuation/back-edge so a huge count with an empty q cannot evade cancellation. Use kernel_storage.fromValues for poll-aware final materialization and checkAllAllocationFailures over every state/child/result allocation.

changes: Make the existing BinaryOp/UnaryOp enum fields and their comptime primitive adapters the registry source. Each declarative entry carries an exact phrase pattern, eligible execution context, expected primitive identities, captured literal slots, and fast target; do not maintain a second spelling-to-operation switch in idioms.zig.

The matcher is general over exact phrase length and structure but the M6 registry remains closed: each `(unary)`, each `(constant binary)`, each `(constant swap binary)`; each2 `(binary)`; fold/scan `(+)`, `(*)`, `(min)`, `(max)`; and direct application `(dup grade at)`. Constants are inert Values and every literal/word position must match exactly.

At ordinary word dispatch, submit the stored source body with context direct before scheduleWord; at combinator entry, submit the supplied quotation with its each/each2/fold/scan context and operands. Both routes use the same tryApply callback. A direct miss schedules the untouched stored body, while a combinator miss starts Patch 2's generic per-application continuation.

For each referenced word, call Machine.resolveName in the exact scope/home the generic phrase would use, require Resolution.origin == .core and the lease's primitive pointer to equal the registry entry, then release the lease before running. Reduction fast paths are sequential left folds for every numeric representation. No float reassociation, SIMD tree, or future-worker split is permitted; integer/min/max optimization is optional only if the differential remains exact.

A guard failure performs no snapshotting: Patch 2 schedules the quotation afresh for every application and each word occurrence resolves through ordinary dispatch, so redefinition between applications remains visible.

files.description: Implement registry-complete in-process automatic/generic cases and hit assertions.
Implement shared M6 Zig/Rust cases and full manifest coverage without touching the oracle.
Wire named `differential` test artifact and retain separate oracle step.
Add blocking differential task.
Release-binary success/control/derived-word fixture.
DoD-10 late-binding fixture.
Implement and unskip M6 contract/late-binding/empty-directory embedded-prelude acceptance.
Document live M6 surface, application contracts, source bodies, and verification commands.

changes: Build an exhaustive case manifest from the same public kernels.Registry/idiom pattern categories consumed by recognition. For each eligible entry, generate representative atom/leaf/spine/empty/error/float cases, run one Session in automatic and one in generic_only, and fail unless automatic records the expected hit and generic records zero.

Compare successes by equal.match, heap kind/printed canonical representation, and recursively bit-cast every float leaf; compare failures as complete d.19 Values plus canonical representation. Do not normalize away data.index/effect, source, word, or trace.

Add `zig build differential` as a toolchain-independent test artifact importing the ecl module. Add it as its own blocking SourceHut task so a missing recognizer, stale registry entry, or parity failure cannot hide inside the Cargo-backed oracle task.

Extend oracle_differential's manifest/cases for the M6 overlap, including parse success/failure/non-execution, and permit separate Zig/Rust source only for settled spelling drift such as `or-raise` versus frozen `ok!`; normalized case syntax is Zig-only because the frozen oracle predates the ruling. Run cargo test/build --locked and git diff --exit-code -- poc/rust exactly as today.

Add release-binary tests for DoD-7 contract index/effect, DoD-10 redefined +, DoD-14 isolated set leakage, DoD-27, normalized case, and parse. The embedded-prelude test copies only the absolute release binary to a fresh temp directory, clears ECL_PATH, sets cwd there, asserts exact body/pack output, and proves slurp/spit/getenv/lines remain undefined.

Document only implemented M6 words, the flat cond/case distinction, and pure parse; explicitly defer filesystem/environment words and distinguish `zig build differential` (fast/generic, no Rust) from `zig build oracle-differential` (frozen external oracle).
